FOUND.name: organiser_off_at
FOUND.exact_effect: y = self.n['Y'].copy(); self.n['Y'] -= y; self.n['WY'] += y
FOUND.spatial_scope: GLOBAL — the entire Y field is zeroed in one operation
FOUND.other_physics_touched: none. Occupancy is conserved exactly, no X molecule is moved, created or destroyed, no resource is touched. Y leaves through the same Y->WY channel a spontaneous decay uses.
FOUND.control_field: constructor keyword organiser_off_at, threaded through protocol_obtc02.py:81
FOUND.runner_path: protocol_obtc02.py builds R arms with track=True, organiser_off_at=off
FOUND.already_used_by: the OBTC02 CAUSAL_SOURCE_DEPENDENCE R arms, which measured the X decay after removing the sole organiser

FOUND.name: organiser_immobile
FOUND.exact_effect: the organiser's hop probability is set to 0 in the Spec
FOUND.spatial_scope: global parameter, not an intervention on one centre

NOT_FOUND: any per-cell or per-centre Y removal
CONSEQUENCE: R2 functional independence cannot be tested with the engine as it stands. Removing the parent with organiser_off_at removes the daughter at the same instant, because the operation is a single global zeroing of the Y field.

SMALLEST_MISSING_CAPABILITY.name: selective_organiser_off
SMALLEST_MISSING_CAPABILITY.specification: at a declared step, remove Y only from the cells belonging to one named spatial centre under the frozen toroidal single-linkage partition, through the same Y->WY channel, conserving occupancy exactly, touching no X and no resource
SMALLEST_MISSING_CAPABILITY.why_it_is_an_intervention_and_not_an_arc: it manipulates the experiment at a declared instant. It adds no term to the autonomous law: between interventions every rate, every candidate rule and every update remains bit-identical. The existing global organiser_off already establishes the precedent and the channel; only the spatial scope changes.
